title: MEIKO — Even Just A Little〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Her singing's improved quite a lot...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Maybe meeting our other selves in that strange SEKAI had a greater effect on her than I realized.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for being such a strong source of support for the others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All we can do is watch over them, but I can see that they're in good hands!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Based on what I've seen watching you all this time, it's obvious to me that they need you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't always have to put what you feel into words. They feel better just knowing that you're there for them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Just as how Rin and I play different roles here, that other me must also have a unique role in all of this.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (All she can do is watch over the others.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (In the sense that we both watch others from a distance, we sort of play similar roles.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (However, the big difference between her and us is that we can directly interact with the person whose feelings gave birth to this place at any time.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Still, I don't plan on doing that any time soon...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(She noticed me...
I was wondering why she stopped singing.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I don't want to interrupt her, so I should probably move further away and...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
MEIKO, wait.
You were listening to me practice just now, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Can you sing with me again like you did earlier?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Earlier...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Oh, I see...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This is how I'm singing it now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I feel like I'm missing something...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't know if this is what you had in mind, but you could try doing something like this...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I like it...
Lemme try that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
...!
That was really good.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I couldn't figure that part out when I was working on it on my own...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How did you learn to sing like that, MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I thought about this while singing just now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I thought about who I want to support.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not just my feeling of wanting to support someone, but also who and with what words...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And about how I'd like those words to affect them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How those words will affect them...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You know what I'm talking about, right, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh...
I think that's how I felt when I sang for Ena...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks, MEIKO...
I'll keep that in mind while I try.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't always have to put what you feel into words. They feel better just knowing that you're there for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll sing with you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm already involved now.
Also, I should probably try something new for a change...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Yeah, I want you to sing with me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're welcome.
